Name: Angel of Gotham
Information:
**Angel of Gotham**

A testament to Gotham’s battle against the cycle of life and death, the Angel of Gotham is an idealized state of undeath and represents the Deadland Count’s vision for mankind as a whole. They are an ascended soul that has broken free from the cycle of rebirth, without becoming what most would associate with being undead. To the living, they have achieved eternal, unchanging life; to the dead, they are a perfect mockery of life that has no flaws; to Gotham, they are the perfect, static form of undeath, which can persist without erosion, reincarnation, or being bound by the grim fate that undead fall into.

Angels of Gotham are spoken of within the Court of Decay as though they are demigods, and they do indeed contain a small fragment of Gotham’s divine essence, but this is mostly ceremonial. In the few cases of an Angel of Gotham existing, they have almost always been born from a favored soul of Gotham, or have been an intended bride or concubine. To reach this state is to become Gotham’s extension, and so he requires the deepest devotion before he bequeaths his fantastic power onto them. Doubly so because their power on the Material Plane is almost as great as an aspect of Gotham himself.

***Indulgent Avatar.*** Gotham himself is a reserved, calculating force of nature who will take hundreds of years to take a single step in his grand plans, but his Angels have had a taste of mortality, as well as the perspective of “true undeath,” and so almost all have been overzealous in pushing Gotham’s vision forward faster than he would. They are intoxicated by their gifts and vainglorious in their seeming perfection, which leads them to be both a walking disaster for the living and prone to the traps of hubris.

Of the limited Angels who have come to be, one managed to retain a conservative perspective and did not wish to waste their gift challenging the world of the living. Instead, they devoted themselves to serving as Gotham’s advisor and agent, limiting their agency in the Material Plane to serve as his right hand.

***Ritual of Ascension.*** The Angel of Gotham is created by infusing a very small part of Gotham’s own essence into a mortal who has already reached the Blood Revenant’s state of pseudo-undeath, and involves a ritual that requires unheard of amounts of arcane energy to create a temporary demiplane in which life and death don’t exist, in which the Angel ascends. Creating one is obscenely difficult, and the world’s logic corrects for the ritual when it’s done, forming like metaphysical scar tissue to prevent the same ascension ritual from being used to create the ascension demiplane a second time. Thanks to this, only a handful of these Angels have ever come to be, and have always assumed the role of the head of Gotham’s Court of Decay when they have.

By taking part in this ascension, their ascension demiplane becomes a part of Gotham’s own divine realm, and they become anchored to it in the way that a fiend would be anchored to the Hells - if their material body is destroyed, then it will reform after a great deal of time within their demiplane. To completely destroy them, they must be destroyed within their demiplane of ascension. Due to the magnitude of their power, an Angel can take a very long time to restore their body, and so their followers may make offerings or perform rituals to hasten their reformation.

***Undeath Traits.*** Though not undead mechanically, the angel does not require sleep, food, air, or water.

Stat Blocks.title: Angel of Gotham
languages: telepathy 480 ft. (undead & followers of Gotham only)

traits.name: Ascension Plane Boon
traits.description: While the angel is within its Ascension Plane, it is empowered. It gains the following benefits:

suboptions.description: It becomes immune to the effects of spells cast at 5th level or lower, unless it wishes to be affected by them.
It gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
The amount of hit points it regenerates each turn doubles.

traits.name: Plane of Ascension (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description: When the angel is reduced to 0 hit points, assuming traits such as Undead Fortitude haven’t prevented this, or they are killed outright, they can choose to allow their body to be destroyed and return to their demiplane of ascension to reform, or they can reset their hit points to 180, regain their spent Legendary Reactions, recharge their actions, and end any effects on itself that it wishes to. For 1 hour, it acts as though within its Plane of Ascension, gaining its benefits. If defeated after using Plane of Ascension, award the party an additional 25,000 XP (for a total of 50,000 XP).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angel makes two Negative Energy Blade attacks, using either its Death Painting or Standing Necrosis.

actions.name: Negative Energy Blade
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target, or a Ranged Spell Attack: +13 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) force damage plus 24 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death Painting (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature the angel has dealt necrotic damage to since the start of its turn must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, their maximum hit points are reduced by the necrotic damage they took. If this reduces a creature’s maximum hit points to 0, they die immediately. On a success, targets take the necrotic damage again, but their maximum hit points aren’t reduced.

actions.name: Mythic Action: Standing Necrosis (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: This action and Death Painting roll to recharge together, and using one causes the other to be spent. The angel spreads dark, twisting strands of life among each target it chooses within 30 feet of a point it can see within 120 feet. Each target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 63 (14d8) necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Each target who fails also suffers a point of Combat Fatigue, unless they are resistant or immune to necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Mythic Action: Coagulant Summons (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: If there are at least 10 Medium corpses within 40 feet of a point the angel can see within 120 feet of themselves, they are joined together to become a gotham’s coagulant mass (see page 254 of this book), appearing at the point chosen, which is under the angel’s control. Corpses larger than Medium count for twice as many corpses for each size category larger they are.

reactions.name: Mythic Action: Zero Out
reactions.description: When a creature the angel can see regains hit points, the angel can use their reaction to force them to make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they do not regain those hit points.

options.name: Strike
options.description: The angel makes a melee attack using Negative Energy Blade against a creature within range.

options.name: Dark Flight
options.description: The angel moves up to its movement speed.

options.name: Swirling Darkness (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: The angel chooses a point within 60 feet of its target, where a 20-foot radius of magical darkness emerges, which remains until the end of its next turn. The angel can see through this darkness as though it had devilsight.

mythic_actions.intro: The creature may use the following actions as Legendary Actions for 1 hour after using their Mythic Awakening.

options.name: Bridal Puppeteer
options.description: The angel can choose one corpse or one dying creature within 60 feet. That creature, if alive, must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, resisting this effect on a success. Otherwise, or if it has no will, the target stands immediately and can move up to its movement speed and take one action it would be capable of, ignoring the dying condition if it has it. Unless it would be higher, any attack the creature makes uses the angel’s own Negative Energy Blade modifier to hit. In addition to any damage its attacks would normally make, they deal an additional d8 of necrotic damage.

options.name: Death Strikes (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: The angel makes two Negative Energy Wave attacks, each at a different target within range. It may move up to 20 feet without provoking opportunity attacks between each attack to reach a second target, but only if it needs to make that movement to approach its intended target.

options.name: Deathly Virtues (Costs 3 Actions)
options.description: The angel attempts to charm one creature that can hear and understand it, by speaking tempting words and filling their head with the thoughts and possibilities of what an existence beyond the scope of life and death could entail. The target must succeed a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of the angel’s next turn. If the target succeeds, they become immune to this effect until next time they Rest.

legendary_reactions.source_conversion_note: Converted from Legendary Resistance (2/Day) per standing formatting rule.
